_comment: KH access-control catalogue. seed.py loads it into the KH_AUTH_* tables. Change behaviour here, not in code. Source: KH pending enhancement 'SSO sign-in with roles and per-scope access control', decisions D1-D13 (2026-09-24).

roles.description: Maintains KH. No restriction anywhere, including the orchestrator. Only a maintainer adds or removes another maintainer (D7, D8).
Everyone who is not a maintainer. Sees only the projects they created or were added to (D6); the orchestrator is read-only.

Administers one company (tenant): its project permissions below apply to every project created by someone of that tenant, orphans included. Held through the realm role 'tenant-admin', which the group /tenants/<tenant>/tenant-admins carries.

Reads every semi-public project (readonly level, see visibility_access). Carried by each tenant group, and given directly to a person with no tenant; a tenant whose group lacks it cannot read semi-public projects.
Reads every public project (readonly level). Carried like semi.read.
Edits the content of every public project (editable level: read, write, worklog; never people or deletion). Carried like semi.read.

_visibility_access: fen 2026-10-13: semi-public and public projects are ordinary projects. Their people keep their grants; on top, whoever holds the role below holds the level on every active project of that visibility (view rule 6). A project's visibility is KH_AUTH_PROJECT.VISIBILITY, set by its owner or a maintainer (PUT /kh/projects/{id}/visibility). Exclude a tenant by removing these roles from its group; seed.py replaces these rows wholesale.
_project_scope: Where a role's PROJECT permissions apply: 'all' (default) = every project, 'tenant' = the projects of the tenants the person administers. Change what a role may do by editing role_permissions below and re-running seed.py - no code change.

levels.description: Full access to the project: content, people (add or remove anyone, owners included) and deleting the project (D3, D12).
Full access to the project's content, but may not touch people or delete the project (D4).
Reads the project only and writes no worklog into it (D4b, D5).

permissions.description: Read and retrieve the project's data: knowledge, logs, findings, graph, policy.
Add, change and delete the project's content.
Write worklogs into the project. Readonly members do not (D5).
Add people to the project, remove them, or change their level.
Delete the whole project, behind a typed 'delete' confirmation (D12).
Create a new project; the creator becomes its owner (D2).
Add, disable or remove KH users (the allow-list).

Bring a NEW person in: adding an e-mail that has no account to a project creates the account. Without it, only people who already have an account can be added, and the caller is told whom to ask. A holder whose role scope is 'tenant' creates people inside their own tenant only.
Promote a user to maintainer or remove a maintainer (D7, D8).

_default_levels: A level every active KH user holds on the project without a grant (fen 2026-09-28). 'lesson-learned' holds the shared lessons and guides (renamed from 'knowledge' 2026-10-05); everyone reads it, its owners and editors edit it. The orchestrator needs no entry: as a system project every user already reads it.
